progress to the final: Only the top two teams in each group will progress to the final, so every match this week is important.
每組只有前兩名的隊伍能晉級決賽，所以這週的每場比賽都很重要。
progress slowly: Work on the new bridge continued to progress slowly because of the heavy rain all summer.
由於整個夏天大雨不斷，新橋的工程持續緩慢進展。
work in progress: My novel is still a work in progress, so please don't share the first chapter with anyone yet.
我的小說仍在進行中，所以請先不要把第一章分享給任何人。
make progress: Since she started reading English news every day, Mia has begun to make progress in her writing.
自從米亞開始每天閱讀英文新聞後，她的寫作已經開始取得進展。
prohibit smoking: Many countries now prohibit smoking in restaurants and on buses to protect people's health.
現在許多國家禁止在餐廳和公車上吸菸，以保護民眾的健康。
be prohibited by law: In Taiwan, selling alcohol to anyone under eighteen is prohibited by law, and shops can be fined.
在台灣，販賣酒類給未滿十八歲的人是法律禁止的，商店可能會被罰款。
prohibit someone from: The new school rule will prohibit students from using their phones during class time.
新校規將禁止學生在上課時間使用手機。
prohibitive costs: Many families cannot send their kids abroad to study because of the prohibitive costs of tuition and housing.
由於學費和住宿費高得嚇人，許多家庭無法送孩子出國留學。
project an image: The company hired a famous actor because it wanted to project an image of being young and modern.
這家公司聘請了一位知名演員，因為它想投射出年輕又現代的形象。
project confidence: During a job interview, try to smile, sit up straight, and project confidence even if you feel nervous.
求職面試時，即使你很緊張，也要試著微笑、坐直並散發自信。
project growth: Experts project growth of about three percent for the economy next year if prices stay stable.
專家預測如果物價保持穩定，明年經濟將成長約百分之三。
project one's voice: On stage, actors must learn to project their voices so people in the back row can hear every word.
在舞台上，演員必須學會放大聲音，讓後排觀眾也能聽清楚每個字。
a projected rise: The news reported a projected rise in temperatures, so farmers are worried about their crops this summer.
新聞報導氣溫預估上升，所以農夫們很擔心今年夏天的農作物。
project onto others: People who feel unhappy about themselves often project onto others the faults they cannot accept in themselves.
對自己不滿意的人常會把自己無法接受的缺點投射到他人身上。
prolong life: Doctors say that eating vegetables and exercising regularly can prolong life and keep the mind sharp.
醫生說多吃蔬菜和規律運動可以延長壽命，並保持頭腦靈活。
prolong the meeting: Please don't ask too many questions at the end, or you will prolong the meeting and everyone will miss lunch.
最後請不要問太多問題，否則你會延長會議，大家都會錯過午餐。
prolong the agony: If you have to tell him the bad news, do it now; waiting will only prolong the agony.
如果你必須告訴他壞消息，現在就說吧；等待只會延長痛苦。
prolonged exposure: Prolonged exposure to strong sunlight can damage your skin, so remember to wear sunscreen at the beach.
長期暴露在強烈陽光下會傷害皮膚，所以在海灘時記得擦防曬乳。
promote health: The school started a free breakfast program to promote health among students from poor families.
學校推出免費早餐計畫，以促進弱勢家庭學生的健康。
promote a product: Many companies pay popular YouTubers to promote a product in their videos instead of using TV ads.
許多公司付錢請受歡迎的 YouTuber 在影片中推銷產品，而不是用電視廣告。
be promoted to manager: After working hard at the hotel for five years, Kevin was promoted to manager last month.
在飯店努力工作五年後，凱文上個月升任經理。
promote peace: The international music festival aims to promote peace by bringing young people from different countries together.
這個國際音樂節旨在透過聚集不同國家的年輕人來促進和平。
promote understanding: Learning a foreign language can promote understanding between people from different cultures.
學習外語可以增進不同文化背景的人之間的理解。
promote growth: The government lowered taxes for small businesses to promote growth in the local economy.
政府為小型企業減稅，以促進地方經濟成長。
prompt a response: The teacher's surprising question managed to prompt a response from even the shyest student in class.
老師出人意料的問題，成功引發了班上最害羞的學生的回應。
prompt someone to act: Her gentle, kind words were enough to prompt someone to act, and soon a boy offered to help the old lady.
她溫和親切的話足以促使某人行動，很快就有個男孩主動幫助那位老太太。
prompt a debate: The plan to ban school uniforms is likely to prompt a debate among parents, teachers, and students.
廢除校服的計畫很可能會引起家長、老師和學生之間的辯論。
prompt an actor: Her job backstage is to prompt an actor quietly whenever he forgets his lines during the school play.
她在後台的工作是每當演員在校園話劇中忘詞時，悄悄地給演員提詞。
a prompt reply: Thank you for your email; I will try to send you a prompt reply as soon as I check the schedule.
謝謝你的來信；我一確認行程，就會盡量給你即時回覆。
